statements.status_notes: DHI pkg-lvm2 on Debian trixie backports upstream libdm section nesting depth limits (https://github.com/lvmteam/lvm2/commit/1ce29f98c2ff3a62938bb29abfb466a2249f42cc) so deeply nested configuration cannot exhaust the stack. Debian lvm2 2.03.31-2 in trixie remains unfixed per https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-19617.
